findings: Cockpit composition delivered: a persistent FRESHNESS bar + glance-order sections SYSTEM HEALTH / NEEDS YOU / CUSTOMER-OUTCOME / WHAT IS RUNNING / WORK SUPPLY / AUTONOMY / SINCE YOUR LAST VISIT above the Owner abstraction boundary; AGENT MANAGER / NETWORK / QUALITY / AI-GOVERNANCE / full OPERABILITY matrix below it behind a single 'Machinery' expander. Mobile single-column priority defined.

Proposed adapter projection shape mapped each section to EXISTING durable state or an honest gap: systemHealth (governed conditions, no %), needsYou (triageClass proxy from OWNER_DECISION/PROTECTED_ACTION), workSupply (coarse READY/RUNNING counts; DRAINED legitimate), autonomy (from unattended-readiness; authorityExpansions must be 0), operability (6-lane distribution from existing dimensions, never a %), sinceLastVisit (PR-sequence, client-diffed).

GROUNDING CORRECTION: the worker read the Owner's LOCAL C:/Users/Rudy2/Taylor_Parts checkout, which is BEHIND origin/main — so it reported freshnessState + the review/contract docs as 'missing' when they are merged (#738/#741/#742). Illustrates the launcher's source-freshness concern; the design remains valid.
